group.label: Legal Guarantee Notice
group.comment: EU harmonised notice on the legal guarantee of conformity and EU GARAN label (Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/1960, applicable from 27 September 2026). Where they appear is decided by the storefront. This module does not constitute legal advice.

field.label: Enable
field.comment: Kill switch: "No" makes the garanNotice query and every GARAN field return null and removes the email additions for this scope.

field.label: Notice Language
field.comment: Selects which of the 24 official notice versions and which Your Europe link are served. Empty follows the store locale, then English.

field.label: Product Types Without Legal Guarantee
field.comment: Non-goods such as gift cards or downloads: they never get a GARAN label, and Cart.garan_notice_required and the email notice ignore them.

group.label: EU GARAN Label
group.comment: Only for products whose producer offers a commercial guarantee of durability free of charge, for the entire good and for more than two years. Maintain the duration on the product (group "EU GARAN Guarantee"); brand, model identifier and terms URL can come from the settings below. A variant without its own values inherits them from its configurable parent.

field.label: Enable GARAN Label
field.comment: Needs the notice to be enabled too. "No" makes garan_label / garan_labels return null and stops the order item snapshot.

field.label: Brand Comes From
field.comment: A brand maintained on the product always wins. Brand and model identifier share one line on the label: a value that is too long is rejected, not shrunk, and the product then shows no label at all.

field.label: Brand Product Attribute
field.comment: Read for products without their own GARAN brand; select attributes resolve to their option label.

field.label: Brand
field.comment: Printed on the label of every product without its own GARAN brand.

field.label: Model Identifier Comes From
field.comment: A model identifier maintained on the product always wins. Careful with "Product name": most names are too long for the label line shared with the brand, and a value that does not fit means no label at all.

field.label: Guarantee Terms URL
field.comment: Used for every product without its own URL. Full http:// or https:// address in the store view language; without any URL no label is served.

group.label: Order Confirmation Email
group.comment: Magento still sends the order confirmation in a headless setup, so the notice, the labels and the guarantee terms travel with it.

field.label: Legal Guarantee Notice
field.comment: "Inline" puts the notice graphic below the items; "As a file attachment" sends it as a PNG instead, readable in clients that block remote images.

field.label: GARAN Labels
field.comment: Labels come from the snapshot taken at order placement. "As a file attachment" sends one PNG per labelled item, named after its SKU.

field.label: Attach Guarantee Terms
field.comment: The guarantee statement must reach the consumer on a durable medium at the latest at delivery (Art. 17(2) Directive (EU) 2019/771); a link to a website is not sufficient (CJEU C-49/11). Attached only to orders with at least one GARAN-labelled item.

field.label: Guarantee Terms File (PDF)
field.comment: One document per store view. It must name the goods it covers, e.g. "applies to all products of brand X carrying the GARAN label".

field.label: Attachment File Name
field.comment: Name the customer sees in the email. Leave empty for the uploaded file name.
